text: {"lessons":["Diversifying across several stocks can help spread risk, but I should still review each holding rather than assume they will move alike.","Selling Stock B after a large loss and buying more of A and C shows how reacting to recent performance can lead to poorly timed trades; I should use a clear plan instead.","I should keep enough cash for future opportunities and remember that short-term account gains do not guarantee I will reach my apartment goal."]}
